basic_details.short_information: National Law University Delhi (NLUD) has announced recruitment for 2 vacancies including Professor of Practice (Full Time), under advertisement number NLUD/Admin./2026/2864. This purely temporary appointment offers a pay of Rs. 1,50,000 for the Professor of Practice (Full Time) post, requiring distinguished experts with at least 15 years of experience in relevant profession. Eligible candidates can apply online through the careers portal by paying the non-refundable application fee of Rs. 1,000 online, with the last date for submission on 31 October 2026. content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: Selected candidates will receive a consolidated monthly remuneration of Rs. 1,50,000/-. The appointment is purely temporary and will not confer any right to regularization, nor will it carry benefits applicable to regular faculty. The appointment is subject to verification of antecedents and may be terminated at any time due to misconduct, unsatisfactory performance, or subsequent ineligibility.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NLUD Professor of Practice
content_sections.text: Access the application form online at careers portal . Pay the non-refundable application fee of Rs. 1,000/- online (SC/ST and PwD candidates are exempted from the fee). Send the details, expressing intent to apply along with ideas, plans, and curriculum vitae, to [email protected] . Submit the online application on or before 31 October 2026 at 11:59 p.m.

faq.question: Q1. Is this Professor of Practice position permanent?
faq.answer: No, the appointment is purely temporary and will not confer any right to regularization, nor does it carry benefits applicable to regular faculty.

faq.question: Q2. Who is exempted from paying the application fee?
faq.answer: SC/ST and PwD category candidates are exempted from the non-refundable application fee of Rs. 1,000/-.

faq.question: Q3. What is the required experience for this position?
faq.answer: Candidates must have at least 15 years of service or experience in their specific profession or role, preferably at a senior level, with remarkable contributions and proven expertise.

faq.question: Q4. Are formal academic qualifications mandatory for the Professor of Practice post?
faq.answer: A formal academic qualification is not considered essential if the candidate has exemplary professional practice in lieu, and they are exempted from the requirement of publications.

faq.question: Q5. What is the last date to submit the application?
faq.answer: The last date for submission of applications is 31 October 2026 at 11:59 p.m.
